description: Run Adobe Analytics reports, trends and totals, manage segments and annotations, and start workflows when segments, projects, annotations or new dimension values appear.

adobe_analytics_calculated_metric_change.description: Runs for each calculated metric added or changed in Adobe Analytics. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 100. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.calculated_metric: The whole calculated metric as Adobe gives it.
output.name: The calculated metric's name.
output.rsid: The report suite it was made in.

parameters.description: Only those made in this report suite. Leave empty for all.
parameters.name: rsid

adobe_analytics_new_annotation_trigger.description: Runs for each new annotation in Adobe Analytics. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 100. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.annotation: The whole annotation as Adobe gives it.
output.date_range: The dates it covers, as start/end.
output.name: The annotation's name.
output.rsid: The report suite it is on.

adobe_analytics_new_calculated_metric_tr.description: Runs for each new calculated metric in Adobe Analytics. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 100. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.calculated_metric: The whole calculated metric as Adobe gives it.
output.name: The calculated metric's name.
output.rsid: The report suite it was made in.

parameters.description: Only those made in this report suite. Leave empty for all.
parameters.name: rsid

adobe_analytics_new_date_range_trigger.description: Runs for each new saved date range in Adobe Analytics. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 1,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.date_range: The whole date range as Adobe gives it.
output.definition: Its dates or rolling rule, such as tw-6w/tw.
output.name: The date range's name.

adobe_analytics_new_dimension_value_trig.description: Runs when a value of a dimension (a page, a campaign tracking code, a referring domain) appears among its top 1,000 of the last 7 days for the first time. Values already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It checks at most every 30 minutes, as Adobe asks.

output.item_id: Adobe's id for the value, for a breakdown.
output.seen_on: The day it was first seen.
output.value: The new value, such as a page name.

parameters.description: The report suite to watch.
parameters.name: rsid

parameters.description: The dimension to watch, such as Page or Tracking Code. Pick a report suite first, or give an id such as variables/page.
parameters.name: dimension

adobe_analytics_new_project_trigger.description: Runs for each new Workspace project in Adobe Analytics. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 1,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.name: The project's name.
output.project: The whole project as Adobe gives it.
output.rsid: The report suite it was made in.

adobe_analytics_new_segment_trigger.description: Runs for each new segment in Adobe Analytics. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 100. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.name: The segment's name.
output.rsid: The report suite it was made in.
output.segment: The whole segment as Adobe gives it.

parameters.description: Only those made in this report suite. Leave empty for all.
parameters.name: rsid

adobe_analytics_new_usage_log_trigger.description: Runs for each new entry in Adobe Analytics' usage log: sign-ins, reports run, settings changed. Needs an admin credential. Entries from before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.event: What happened, such as User logged in.
output.event_type: Adobe's number for the kind of event.
output.ip_address: The IP address it came from.
